title: Generating polynomial coefficients
statement: For a positive integer $n$, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ and let $j\ge 0$. The coefficient of $t^j$ in $\prod_{i=1}^n(1+x_i t)$ equals $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\},\,|S|=j}\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign vector x of length n
